name: vibecoding
description: AI-powered project planning and execution — generate dependency-aware roadmaps and execute them phase-by-phase with parallel agents

parallelAgentLimit.title: Parallel agent limit
parallelAgentLimit.description: Maximum number of phase-executor agents dispatched in parallel per phase. Set lower (e.g. 2) to reduce churn; higher (e.g. 6) when machine and token budget allow.

defaultEffort.title: Default agent effort
defaultEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for dispatched agents (low | medium | high | xhigh). xhigh requires Opus 4.7 or later.

worktreeParentDir.title: Worktree parent directory
worktreeParentDir.description: Directory under which parallel phase-executor worktrees are created. Relative paths are resolved against the project root.

autoCommitOnACPass.title: Auto-commit on AC pass
autoCommitOnACPass.description: When true, phase-executor commits automatically after AC verification passes. When false, leaves staged changes for user review.

runPhaseReviewer.title: Run phase reviewer after integration check
runPhaseReviewer.description: When true, execute-roadmap dispatches the phase-reviewer agent after integration checks pass, before the user checkpoint.
